# Unboxing & Comparison Review

Reusable templates for unboxing and comparison-review ecommerce videos: a 7-segment unboxing structure (30–45s) and an 8-row comparison structure (45–60s) with voice-over points and storyboard output, fair-comparison rules (same conditions, show the process, keep raw records, no competitor disparagement, no absolute claims), a shot checklist, a real flaw and who-it-is-not-for in every review, and local Pillow product cards for summary, comparison and end cards.
